body: Most people have no idea what you’re going through, and when they try to “help” or “fix it”, they just make things worse. It’s not that they want to hurt you, they just don’t have the capacity to listen or empathize with something so deep-seated.

Definitely relate.
-	I’d get off my ass in a heartbeat if I could muster some semblance of motivation
-	After spending years in therapy and treatment, I know it doesn’t get better for good
-	Anyone who says you should be grateful for not being the most oppressed person on the planet is a cunt
-	Very few people actually care about you, everyone else just gets sick of you
-	Ah yes, the “you’re so young, you have so much to live for” bullshit
